text: Chief decision: separate the estimand. Segment structural cost = reducer over per-chart pair costs on charts where BOTH a chart match and a provider estimate exist; missingness is reported separately (charts without estimate, provider abstentions) and never enters the cost as a 0.5 constant; coverage reports successful estimates, not chart counts. Reducer choice is data in the receipt (member ids + reducer name). Properties: adding an incompatible chart cannot lower cost; abstention cannot lower cost; permutation invariance; leaf equivalence.
